findings.fix: Split the line into named steps or wrap it
findings.why: A long line hides logic past the edge of the screen and in review diffs

findings.fix: Give each condition a name or put each statement on its own line
findings.snippet: size n = if n < 1 then A else if n < 2 then B else if n < 3 then C else if n < 4 then D else if n < 5 then E else F
findings.why: Several conditions or statements on one line are hard to read and to review

findings.fix: Use guards, a case expression or a sum type
findings.snippet: else if n < 2 then B else if n < 3 then C else if n < 4 then D else if
findings.why: A chain of else-if branches hides the cases that guards or a sum type would name
